newsitem.title: SPAIN: BBV, Telepizza chairman's gp sell Telepizza shares. [CORRECTED 18:53 GMT]
newsitem.headline: BBV, Telepizza chairman's gp sell Telepizza shares. [CORRECTED 18:53 GMT]

text.p: A unit of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya and Transeuropean Research Traders, which is controlled by Telepizza chairman Leopoldo Fernandez Pujals, sold 9.55 percent of Telepizza at 8,000 pesetas a share, Spain's Stock Market Commission CNMV said on Thursday.

"Bilbao Vizcaya Holdings, a unit of Banco Bilbao Vizcaya S.A., and Transeuropean Research Traders SA, a company controlled by Leopoldo Fernandez Pujals, sold... on June 19 485,000 and 541,000 shares, respectively, to institutional investors, at 8,000 pesetas a share," according to a mandatory disclosure filed by Telepizza with the CNMV.
The two groups said they had committed themselves to not making any further sales in the next 90 days.
Both groups said they consider their participation in Telepizza as "stable".
The operation was made throughout the day as a block trade, to ensure normal price evolution was not distorted.
After this operation, Bilbao Vizcaya Holdings and those shares controlled by Fernandez Pujals represented 44 percent of the group. (Corrects by replacing Telepizza with Fernandez Pujals.)
